abstract: The rationale for further treatment after orchiectomy and the logical basis of the principle therapeutic alternatives in the management of clinical state I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis have been reviewed. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection provides the epitome of staging accuracy and a high degree of therapeutic effectiveness in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis and is associated with minimal early and late morbidity and a low mortality. However, all methods of further active therapy after radical orchiectomy are under legitimate scrutiny in view of the burden of unnecessary therapy, the accuracy of clinical staging, the ability to recognize failures early, and the high probability of successful treatment of such failures.
abstract_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣に対する根治的精巣摘除術後の追加治療の根拠と、主要な治療選択肢の論理的基盤をレビューした。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における病期分類の精度と高い治療効果の典型であり、早期および晩期の合併症や死亡率も低い。しかし、根治的精巣摘除術後のすべての積極的治療法は、不要な治療の負担、臨床病期分類の精度、早期の再発を認識する能力、そしてそのような再発を治療できる高い確率という観点から、正当な検討の対象となっている。
